app_description: Advanced luxury coffee-cart business management platform featuring POS cashier, recipe inventory, rider stock & photo evidence, rider deposits with receipts & WhatsApp export, financial ledger, salary/incentive tier progression (Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum), real-time Leaflet GPS tracking, and role-based views (Superadmin, Bar Team, Rider).
design_archetype: Luxury App Store Minimalist Bento Grid

desktop.structure: Sidebar Navigation on left (fixed width w-64/w-72), main scrollable content area on right.
desktop.navigation_profile: Profile avatar & user credentials positioned at top-right or bottom of navigation sidebar.

mobile.structure: Bottom Navigation Bar (fixed bottom z-50), custom role-specific simplified touch-first interface.
mobile.navigation_profile: Profile badge positioned on top-right of the mobile header bar.

bento_grid.card_style: rounded-2xl border border-border/60 bg-card p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all relative overflow-hidden

features: Quick Role switcher demo pills for Superadmin, Bar Team, Rider

pos_cashier.product_grid: Tap-to-add category filtered items with live stock badges & price
pos_cashier.cart_drawer: Running total calculation, discount selection, cash payment modal with live change calculator
pos_cashier.receipt_modal: App Store aesthetic formatted receipt card with quick screenshot/download button & WhatsApp share link

rider_management.stock_and_evidence: Interactive stock table with dropdown selectors, photo upload simulation preview
rider_management.deposit_and_receipt: Rider daily cash deposit ledger with receipt generation and direct WhatsApp notification export

dashboard_and_analytics.charts: Recharts visual analytics for sales trends, peak hours, and stock depletion rate
dashboard_and_analytics.leaflet_gps_map: Interactive Leaflet map displaying active coffee cart rider locations in real-time

financials_and_tiers.financial_report: Income, Expense, Cash Handover logs with filterable date range
financials_and_tiers.salary_tier: Gamified progression bar showing Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum threshold status and bonus calculations

image_urls.description: Iced latte espresso drink in clear glass for POS item display
Hot Cappuccino Latte art cup on wooden table
Flat lay ground coffee beans and portafilter for inventory recipe header
Elegant cafe latte with heart art on dark black background

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive element (button, input, select, tab, chart container, badge, card) MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per project setup.
Ensure both Light and Dark themes work seamlessly via dark class toggle on document root.
Support EN and ID (Indonesian) language toggle across all key texts, labels, and receipts.
All cards in Bento grid should feature smooth hover transitions, clean padding, and gold gradient accent borders where highlighted.
Implement Sonner toasts for cart additions, stock updates, cash handovers, and receipt exports.
In Leaflet map components, dynamically handle map tiles and custom pin markers for active coffee riders.
